history.summary: Local Jagannath temple in Old Housing Board Colony, Panipat. Devotee reviews state it was built about 120 years ago (i.e. c. 1906) and that its Rath Yatra is held on the same day as the Puri Rath Yatra with great pomp — no authoritative source for the founding date was found (UNVERIFIED). The presiding deities are Jagannath, Balabhadra and Subhadra, in wooden-style iconography following the Puri tradition.

town_description: Panipat is a historic city in Haryana on the Grand Trunk Road (NH-44), about 90 km north of Delhi, famous for three pivotal battles (1526, 1556, 1761) that shaped Indian history. Today it is one of India's largest centres for handloom weaving, blankets and carpets, and an industrial hub in the National Capital Region. Its dense mix of Mughal-era and Maratha-era heritage sites draws both pilgrims and history tourists.
